svg.title: The slow cook: no crash, four slow burns
svg.desc: Timeline from 1929 to 2030 and four panels: US trust in mass media 68% in 1972 to 28% in 2025; Singapore resident fertility 1.24 in 2015 to 0.87 in 2025; global employee engagement peaking at 23% in 2022 and falling to 20% in 2025; global wealth shares in 2025, top 10% 75%, middle 40% 23%, bottom 50% 2%.
svg.text: A burst is loud and dated. These forces are quiet, and they are all moving the same way.
% trusting “a great deal” or “a fair amount”
Total fertility rate, births per woman
Peak 2022–23; two straight years of decline
One end lacks reason to strive; the other, belief that striving works
Sources: Gallup (2025); Singapore Dept of Statistics (2026); Gallup State of the Global Workplace 2026; World Inequality Report 2026; Imperva Bad Bot Report 2025; FTC; FDR Library.
Panels show selected years where noted. Adrian Chan · adriansays.com
